about: The model providers' reply bodies: Open Responses, Chat Completions and Gemini native streams, and one whole Chat Completions body, as the providers sent them. coax/lib/gateway/ is the only folder that parses them (sse.coax, gateway.coax, chat.coax); what comes out is our own GwEvent and GwUsage. Each fixture names a recording under coax/lib/gateway/fixtures/ (its README.md says where each came from; all were carried over from crates/coder/fixtures/gateway/ at 0b401561a0^) and the values the gateway must give for it: the answer's text and its length, how many text and reasoning deltas, one done, no refusal, the reason, the provider OpenRouter names, and the usage. The request bodies are our own writing (gw_translate) and are held byte for byte by the gateway's tests, not here. Not here: fixtures/anthropic-text.sse and anthropic-tool.sse, which are written by hand from Anthropic's documentation and are no recording; the Anthropic Messages wire has no fixture of real bytes yet. Checked by coax/lib/gateway/gateway-external-profile.coax.
